    • SimCharacter

      public SimCharacter(String name, String gender)
      Constructs SimCharacter with name and gender. Initialises the Sim at age 18 with starting funds and default needs.
      Parameters:
      name - Name for new Sim.
      gender - Gender for new Sim.

    • perform

      public void perform(Activity activity, GameContext context)
      Sim to perform specific activity. If alive, Sim applies the activity's effects, advances game time, and updates their mood based on the resulting need changes.
      Parameters:
      activity - Action to be performed.
      context - Printing notifications and advancing time.

    • checkDeath

      public void checkDeath(GameContext context)
      Evaluates whether Sim has died from critical neglect. Sim dies if hunger or energy remains at zero for one full day.
      Parameters:
      context - Printing notifications and advancing time.
